commits.summary: Countermodels of the pair of versions: five false proofs of agreement, reproduced and handed to the preservation stream
commits.body: The challenge stream's item 1. lib/tests/fixtures/pairing-countermodels holds two versions of five methods that differ when each runs alone on a JVM and that RegressionPair.agree (lib/src/pairing.rs) proves agreeing: the previous version sets the default locale the new one lowers under; a library static shared without --before-classpath; two unrelated RuntimeExceptions, and IllegalArgumentException against a subclass, compared by category; a scope that is false everywhere but sets the default locale before both calls. All five were Verified on the checker at lupovnmv. The order of the calls is observable: with the versions' roles swapped, and with --before-classpath, the shared-static case is a violation.
